nodes.label: AuthProvider seam
nodes.rationale: One getUser/signIn/signOut/onAuthChange signature keeps future providers swappable and preserves anonymous flow with no login screen yet.

nodes.label: Authentication
nodes.rationale: Real auth deferred but seam-locked now so email+password and OAuth can plug into same AuthProvider signature without UI rework.

nodes.label: src/config constants package
nodes.rationale: Single source for behavior constants; locked by tests/config.test.ts so behavior changes happen only here.

nodes.label: DocStorage seam with IDB adapter
nodes.rationale: Interface plus setStorage swap enables per-user namespace later without rewriting callers.

nodes.label: IndexedDB local source of truth
nodes.rationale: Cookies/localStorage rejected (4KB + per-request overhead); MBs of strokes and PDF/image bytes require IndexedDB docs and files stores with versioned optional-field migration.

nodes.label: Membership
nodes.rationale: Membership only unlocks cloud (sync/quota/sharing); tier is badge not gate, so local stays fully usable without locks.

nodes.label: Anonymous to account migration modal default YES
nodes.norm_label: anonymous to account migration modal default yes
nodes.rationale: Explicit one-click modal defaulting YES preserves local work on login while avoiding risky automatic merge.

nodes.label: Calem import never auto-uploads
nodes.rationale: Prevent surprise cloud writes and quota use; imported .calem stays local until user explicitly syncs.

nodes.label: Email plus password provider
nodes.rationale: Locked as separate provider behind same AuthProvider signature to allow classic login without forking auth flow.

nodes.label: MembershipTier quota gates
nodes.rationale: Pure canAddPage/storageQuotaBytes functions isolate quota policy so numbers can be finalized last without touching call sites.

nodes.label: No local feature locks
nodes.rationale: Membership only unlocks cloud; keeping local ungated avoids paywalling offline core and simplifies enforcement to sync/quota/sharing.

nodes.label: OAuth Google provider
nodes.rationale: Locked as separate provider behind same AuthProvider signature; local remains third provider with no login UI yet.

nodes.label: Page-level last-write-wins conflict rule
nodes.rationale: Merging by page updatedAt avoids whole-document conflicts and keeps concurrent page edits simple and predictable.

nodes.label: Page tombstones for deletes
nodes.rationale: Deleted pages need tombstones so deletes propagate instead of resurrecting on sync.

nodes.label: Quota placeholders in config membership
nodes.rationale: Quota numbers deferred to config/membership.ts placeholders so policy finalization does not block seams.

nodes.label: Offline-first outbox sync engine
nodes.rationale: Offline-first outbox with {v,savedAt} versioning tolerates offline edits; page-level merge and content-addressed bytes minimize conflicts and re-uploads.

nodes.label: Per-user key namespace and ownerId migration
nodes.norm_label: per-user key namespace and ownerid migration
nodes.rationale: User-scoped keys plus ownerId keep accounts isolated; backward-compatible migration assigns existing data to anonymous local owner.
